document.purpose: Human and agent-readable map of the a2b website, its public agent interfaces, deployment path, external dependencies, controls, and change procedures.

identityLock.approvalPolicy: No visual changes, production DNS changes, destructive actions, email-sending changes, spend, credential decisions, legal commitments, or irreversible actions without owner approval.

nodes.title: Cloudflare DNS and edge security
nodes.subtitle: a2b.sa authoritative DNS, proxy, DNSSEC and WAF
nodes.responsibility: Resolve and proxy the canonical a2b web hosts, preserve Google Workspace records, validate DNSSEC, and apply narrowly scoped edge security controls before Vercel.

nodes.title: Edge middleware
nodes.subtitle: Language redirects and Markdown negotiation
nodes.responsibility: Normalize legacy language queries, parse Accept media ranges and q-values, serve direct Markdown sidecars with noindex headers, rewrite canonical requests when Markdown wins, and advertise page-specific Markdown alternates on HTML and HEAD responses.

nodes.title: Security & representation headers
nodes.subtitle: CSP, HSTS, canonical and Content-Signal
nodes.responsibility: Apply global browser security controls and route-specific content types, language, canonical, alternate representation, cache variation, noindex, and agent-policy headers.

nodes.subtitle: llms, OpenAPI, well-known cards and auth policy

nodes.title: Markdown-for-agents layer
nodes.subtitle: 65 deterministic companions
nodes.responsibility: Generate main-content Markdown from canonical HTML and serve it through content negotiation or direct noindex sidecars.

nodes.title: Browser WebMCP bridge
nodes.subtitle: 7 in-page read-only tools
nodes.responsibility: Register browser-aware tools only when navigator.modelContext is available, fetch same-origin public resources, call the agent concierge, classify requests, and emit privacy-safe GA4 events.

nodes.title: Server-side MCP endpoint
nodes.subtitle: 9 read-only tools + 18 resources
nodes.responsibility: Serve JSON-RPC-style initialize, tools, and resources operations; classify scope and prepare inquiries/RFQs without contacting a2b.
notes: Reads repository files first and falls back to the production URL if local reads fail.
Rejects non-JSON and oversized bodies, rate limits per transient client key, and accepts only canonical production hosts.
Returns no-store responses and never sends email, submits forms, quotes prices, or creates commitments.

nodes.title: Deterministic agent concierge
nodes.subtitle: Public facts only, no model or database
nodes.responsibility: Answer agent and procurement questions from allowlisted public a2b facts, classify fit, explain safe next steps, and flag new unanswered questions after redaction.
notes: No paid AI call, database, private tools, environment-secret read, outbound message, or commercial authority.
Answered question content is not logged. New unanswered questions are logged once after redaction.
Application controls remain effective on the origin; the shared Cloudflare path-level counter is planned but remains pending a2b WAF-management permission.

flows.title: Human HTML page request
flows.description: A browser resolves the domain, reaches Vercel, passes through middleware without a Markdown request, and receives canonical HTML plus static assets.
flows.trigger: GET canonical URL with normal browser Accept headers
verification: visual regression screenshots when page HTML/CSS changes
flows.approvalBoundary: Visual output changes require owner approval.

flows.title: Canonical URL to Markdown
flows.description: An agent asks the normal canonical URL for Markdown. Middleware compares supported HTML and Markdown media ranges using q-values and specificity, defaults equal explicit preferences and ambiguous requests to HTML, returns 406 when both representations are explicitly unacceptable, and applies canonical, alternate, language, content-signal, and cache-variation headers.
flows.trigger: GET or HEAD canonical URL where text/markdown wins standards-correct Accept negotiation

flows.title: Agent discovery
flows.description: A crawler or agent reads crawler policy, llms guidance, well-known cards, OpenAPI, structured resources, and Markdown coverage before choosing a read-only interface.
verification: live GET checks for llms.txt, openapi.json, .well-known files and data resources

flows.title: Server MCP tool or resource call
flows.description: An agent discovers the endpoint, sends a JSON-RPC-style request, the function reads public repository data, and returns a read-only result with a request ID.
verification: representative fit, non-fit, careers and vendor routing calls
flows.approvalBoundary: The API cannot submit forms, send email, quote pricing, confirm availability, or create commitments.

flows.title: Agent concierge question
flows.description: An external agent discovers the concierge, sends a small JSON question through Cloudflare, and receives a deterministic answer grounded in approved public a2b facts. New unanswered questions are redacted and marked for owner knowledge review.
verification: live answered, unanswered, invalid-content-type, oversized-body and rate-limit checks
confirm application logs contain no answered question text or source IP
flows.approvalBoundary: The concierge cannot access private systems, accept personal data or secrets, contact a2b, quote pricing, confirm availability, or create commitments.

flows.title: Browser WebMCP call
flows.description: A browser-aware agent loads a homepage, the bridge registers seven read-only tools when navigator.modelContext is supported, reads same-origin JSON resources, and emits only event metadata to GA4.
verification: confirm GA4 event names contain no submitted business fields
flows.approvalBoundary: The browser tools prepare and classify only.

flows.title: Vendor or careers handoff
flows.description: The visitor completes a local form; JavaScript sanitizes and places the public fields in a mailto draft, the user's mail client controls sending, and the page records only form-attempt/completion events.
verification: manual mailto draft check without sending
flows.approvalBoundary: Changing email-sending behavior requires owner approval.

flows.title: Search discovery and indexing
flows.description: Search crawlers consume robots, sitemap, canonical HTML, hreflang, JSON-LD, and optional IndexNow notifications.
flows.trigger: Crawler visit, sitemap fetch, or IndexNow submission
verification: logged-in Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools checks
flows.approvalBoundary: No paid tools or backlinks without approval.

flows.title: Source to production
flows.description: Approved source changes pass repository checks, are committed and pushed to GitHub, deploy through the bound Vercel project, and are verified live with rollback retained.
flows.approvalBoundary: Production DNS/cutover and visible changes require owner approval.

flows.title: Architecture map maintenance
flows.description: A future architecture-affecting change updates the JSON source, regenerates the standalone HTML, and runs consistency checks before commit.
flows.trigger: Route, interface, runtime, deployment, ownership or external-system change
flows.approvalBoundary: Documentation may proceed autonomously when it records verified facts and does not change production behavior.

securityBoundaries.rule: MCP, WebMCP, and the agent concierge expose only allowlisted public facts and preparation tools.
No public agent endpoint sends email, submits forms, calls phone numbers, quotes prices, confirms availability, or creates commitments.

Public agent APIs accept only canonical-host JSON requests, reject bodies above 32 KB, use transient per-client limits without logging source IPs, and reject sensitive or prompt-injection input on the concierge path.
enforcedBy: Cloudflare free path-level rate limiting, pending a2b WAF-management permission

securityBoundaries.rule: Vercel applies CSP, HSTS, frame denial, nosniff, referrer, permissions and cross-origin policies.
Public content is crawlable; admin, internal, dashboard, private, write API, and agent-auth paths are blocked in robots.
No plaintext secrets belong in prompts, docs, source, logs, or repository history.
All accounts, repositories, analytics, hosting, DNS, Paperclip and social resources must match a2b before any write.

decisions.decision: No visible website change without owner review and approval.
decisions.impact: Architecture work must remain in internal documentation unless separately approved.

decisions.decision: Allow search and real-time AI input while disallowing AI training.
Public agent tools may read, classify, and prepare but never contact or commit.
Start with a deterministic concierge for external agents only. Use approved public a2b facts, no paid model, no database, no private access, and no visible human chat interface.
Rejected high-intent visual page expansion must not be treated as live, planned, or pending.
SVCB/HTTPS DNS-AID discovery is not required for current site functionality and must not trigger DNS migration without approval.
No public CLI or npm package is maintained because current workflows are repository-local and adequately served by HTTPS, MCP, OpenAPI, and npm validation scripts.

commands.purpose: Validate company identity, routes, structured data, sitemap, analytics, IndexNow, discovery, tool consistency, and accidental artifacts.
Prove generated Markdown companions match canonical HTML.
Validate local q-value negotiation, specificity, ties, wildcards, HEAD, alternate links, sidecar headers, metadata, and sitemap coverage.
Test every canonical production HTML/Markdown representation, HTML HEAD alternate, direct sidecar, and representative live negotiation matrix.
Validate the canonical IndexNow payload without submitting.
Validate concierge methods, schema, size limits, privacy, injection rejection, grounding, logging, duplicate suppression, rate limiting, and MCP exposure.
Regenerate the standalone HTML map from this JSON.
Validate JSON references, identity, inventory, flows, file evidence, and generated HTML synchronization.

rollback.code: Revert the scoped commit or redeploy the prior Vercel production deployment.
rollback.dns: No DNS change is required for repository-only releases.
rollback.architectureMap: Remove or revert the three architecture-map files and their instruction/package references; production is unaffected because docs/architecture is excluded from deployment.

paperclipRecording.rule: Record the architecture artifact, verification evidence, commit, deployment impact, risks, and rollback in online Paperclip when an authenticated a2b session is available.

knownRisks.risk: Google, Bing, DNS, Vercel and Paperclip state can change independently of the repository.
knownRisks.control: Verify the live selected account, project, domain, property and version before external writes.

knownRisks.risk: Vendor and careers forms depend on the visitor's configured mail client and do not guarantee delivery or CV attachment.
knownRisks.control: Preserve the current behavior under visual and email approval rules; verify manually without sending before changes.

knownRisks.risk: Server MCP exposes nine tools while browser WebMCP exposes seven by design; future edits could create undocumented drift.
knownRisks.control: Treat the tool sets in this map as explicit contracts and update discovery plus concierge tests with any change.

knownRisks.risk: Vercel log retention and serverless process-local duplicate or abuse counters are not durable global stores.
knownRisks.control: Keep application limits active, add the canonical Cloudflare shared edge counter only after a2b WAF-management permission is verified, and export only redacted unanswered-question events into the a2b review report.

knownRisks.risk: Agent-skill SHA-256 values can become stale when public source files change.
knownRisks.control: Run npm run verify after public discovery or structured-data changes.

knownRisks.risk: A manually edited system can outgrow its map.
knownRisks.control: Run architecture:check in every architecture-affecting change and update sourceCommitAudited after a full re-audit.

agentInstructions: Apply this architecture only to a2b.
Read identityLock before operating an external system.
Treat data/company.json and verified public pages as the public fact source; treat online Paperclip workspace AB as the operating system of record.
Do not make visual changes without owner approval.
Do not expose repository-internal architecture artifacts publicly.
Do not invent services, certifications, coordinates, pricing, capacity, availability, legal facts, accounts, or credentials.
Do not route careers, vendors, internships, training, B2C, retail, personal delivery, spam, or unrelated requests into project inquiry.
Do not add a public CLI or npm package unless a recurring workflow clearly justifies its maintenance.
Update this JSON and regenerate the HTML when architecture changes.
Run the checks listed in operations.commands before claiming completion.
